seoFallback.heading: Online Sex Dice for Couples — Free, No Signup
seoFallback.lede: A free, browser-based 3D dice game for couples. Five customizable dice tumble with real physics — whichever face lands up forms tonight's prompt: an action, a body part, a duration, an intensity, a position, a mood.
seoFallback.body: No signup. No tracking. No download. The game runs entirely in your browser on any modern device. Pick a Sweet, Spicy, or Wild preset, or build your own deck and edit every face. Works equally well for solo play, in-person, or long-distance over a screen share.
bullets: Real 3D physics — dice actually tumble, collide, and settle
Six categories: action, body part, duration, intensity, position, mood
Sweet, Spicy, and Wild presets, or fully custom dice
Private by default — no account, no tracking, works offline after first load
seoFallback.noscript: This game needs JavaScript and WebGL to render the 3D dice. Enable JavaScript in your browser, or open virtualsexdice.com in a modern browser like Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge.
